description: SandboxPilot (github.com/LeanBytes/SandboxPilot) screenshot plan for MacPacker. MacPacker's launch parameters (-ArchivePath / -NavigatePath / -SelectItem) are a general feature — a way to open an archive and jump to a file inside it from the command line, a script, or automation, not tied to any screenshot tool. This file is simply the first consumer: it tells a screenshot driver which parameters, scenarios and appearances produce MacPacker's localized screenshots. The driver stages `testAssets.archive` somewhere the (sandboxed) app can read it, substitutes {archive}, then runs every scenario x appearance x language. -DisableUpdateChecks and -ExtractDemo are automation/preview flags used only for the shots.
